Role: Manager. Body: { newManagerUserId: string }

item.name: Mess Members

query.description: Optional. Page number.
Optional. Items per page, max 100.
Optional. Leave empty to get all statuses as manager. Use active, pending, rejected, or removed to filter.
Optional. Search by member full name, email, or phone.

request.description: Role: Manager for all statuses; Member+ for status=active. Leave status empty to list all statuses. Optional query params: page, limit, status=active|pending|rejected|removed, searchTerm=name/email/phone. Response includes pagination meta. Requires messId variable.

response.name: Get Members (Member+)

request.description: Role: Member+. Lightweight active member options for selectors/dropdowns such as meal logging. Returns all active members without pagination. Response fields: _id (messMemberId), name, email, phone, avatarUrl, messRole, participation.

response.name: Get Active Member Options (Member+) - Sample

request.description: Role: Manager. Updates a pending join request. Body status allowed values: active, rejected. status=active approves, status=rejected rejects. Requires messId and memberId variables.

Role: Manager. Updates active member meal/billing participation. participation.meals controls whether meal entries can be logged and meal charges apply. participation.sharedExpenses controls whether equal-share expenses/utilities apply. At least one flag is required. Useful for manager-only users who manage a mess but do not eat or share expenses there.
Role: Manager. Removes member from mess. Requires messId and memberId variables.

item.description: Member management within a mess. GET /options returns lightweight active member options without pagination for selectors. GET / returns all statuses for managers when status is omitted and supports ?status=active|pending|rejected|removed plus ?searchTerm= for name/email/phone search. Members can use status=active. PATCH /:memberId/status approves or rejects pending requests with body status=active|rejected. PATCH /:memberId/participation updates participation.meals and participation.sharedExpenses for active members. POST remove requires manager role. All routes protected by messContext middleware.

item.name: Payments

query.description: Optional. Page number.
Optional. Items per page.
Optional. pending, approved, rejected, or canceled.
Optional for managers. Filter payments by mess member id.
Optional. Use my to return only authenticated user records; omit or use all for manager all-records view.

request.description: Role: Member+. Managers list all payments; members list only their own payments. Optional query params: page, limit, status=pending|approved|rejected|canceled, messMemberId (manager only). Response populates messMemberId with member role/status/participation and nested user details. Requires messId variable. Use scope=my on this endpoint for authenticated user payments.

Role: Member+. Creates pending payment record. Body: { messMemberId (ObjectId, optional), amount (number, positive, required), method (string, required), reference (string, optional) }. If messMemberId is omitted, backend uses the authenticated active mess membership. Managers may create for another active member of the same mess; normal members cannot create for others.

Role: Member+. Gets payment details. Managers can view any payment in the mess; members can view only their own. Response populates messMemberId with member role/status/participation and nested user details. Requires messId and paymentId variables.

Role: Member+. Updates pending payment status through one endpoint. Body: { status: "approved" | "rejected" | "canceled" }. Only managers can approve/reject. Members can cancel their own pending payment; managers can cancel any pending payment.

item.description: Payment management. Members can create their own payments; managers can create for any active member. Managers list all payments; members list only their own. Status changes use one PATCH /payments/:paymentId/status endpoint. Only managers approve/reject; members can cancel their own pending payments.

item.name: Expenses

query.description: Optional. Page number.
Optional. Items per page.
Optional. pending, approved, rejected, or canceled.
Optional manager-only filter. Active mess member ObjectId. Members are forced to their own member id.
Optional. mess_cash or personal_cash.
Optional. Use my to return only authenticated user records; omit or use all for manager all-records view.

request.description: Role: Member+. Managers list all expenses; members list only their own expenses. Optional query params: page, limit, paidBy (manager only), fundSource=mess_cash|personal_cash, status=pending|approved|rejected|canceled. Responses populate paidBy with member/user details. Requires messId variable. Expense list supports scope=my for authenticated user expenses.

Role: Member+. Body: { category, amount, date, paidBy?, fundSource, receiptUrl? }. Date accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime and is normalized by Dhaka day. Expense date cannot be in the future. Members can omit paidBy and it defaults to their own active membership. Managers may pass paidBy for another active member of the same mess.
Role: Member+. Managers can view any expense in the mess; members can view only their own expense. Response populates paidBy with member/user details. Requires messId and expenseId variables.

Role: Member+. Updates pending expense status through one endpoint. Body: { status: "approved" | "rejected" | "canceled" }. Only managers can approve/reject. Members can cancel their own pending expense; managers can cancel any pending expense.
Role: Manager. Marks expense as reimbursed. Requires messId and expenseId variables.

item.description: Expense tracking. Members can create expenses; approve/reject/cancel status changes use one PATCH /expenses/:expenseId/status endpoint. Reimbursement remains separate.

item.name: Billing

request.description: Role: Member+. Lists billing cycles. Status values: draft or finalized. A missing month is not finalized yet, so managers may preview/finalize it. finalized cycles should show Reopen Cycle; draft cycles should show Finalize Billing.

query.description: Set to true to include archived historical bills

request.description: Role: Manager. Retrieve all member bills for a specific billing cycle. Optionally include archived history using ?history=true query flag.
Role: Member/Manager. Retrieve the specific bill for the currently logged-in user in the given billing cycle.
Role: Manager. Previews billing without saving. Body: { month (number 1-12, required), year (number, required) }

Role: Manager. Finalizes and saves billing cycle. Body: { month (number 1-12, required), year (number, required) }. Cannot finalize active/future months or months with pending expenses, pending payments, or unpaid utility bills. Finalized months lock meals, expense create/approval, payment approval, utility bill create/pay, and market completion.

Role: Manager. Reopens finalized billing cycle for corrections. Changes status to draft, archives generated member bills, and voids billing-cycle ledger charges. Requires messId and billingCycleId variables.

item.description: Billing cycle management. Managers preview and finalize monthly billing.

item.name: Meals

query.description: Optional. Page number.
Optional. Items per page.
Optional for manager/super admin. Filter by mess member id. Normal members only see their own meals.
Optional for manager/super admin. Search by mess member id, member full name, email, or phone.
Optional date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime. startDate is also accepted.
Optional date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime. endDate is also accepted.
Optional. Use my to return only authenticated user records; omit or use all for manager all-records view.

request.description: Role: Manager sees all meal records; Member sees only own meal records. Optional query params: page, limit(max 100), memberId(manager/super admin only), searchTerm(manager/super admin; mess member id/name/email/phone), start/end or startDate/endDate. Response includes pagination meta and summary totalMeals/totalRecords. Requires messId variable. Meal list supports scope=my for authenticated user records. Meal writes cannot target a future date.

Role: Manager. Creates or updates one member's meal count for a date. Date accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime and is normalized by Dhaka day. Preferred body uses meals breakdown from mess settings mealCategories plus special Guest category, for example { meals: { Breakfast: 1, Lunch: 1, Dinner: 1, Guest: 2 } }. Backend calculates mealCount from meals, so guest meals increase that member's total. Backward compatible body { mealCount: 2 } is also accepted. Counts support 0.5 increments. Regular meals cannot exceed 3; total including Guest cannot exceed 50. Locked if that month has a finalized billing cycle. Also blocked if the member has an approved meal off request for that date; cancel the meal off request first to log meals again.

Role: Manager. Creates or updates meal counts for multiple active members on one date. Date accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime and is normalized by Dhaka day. Preferred entries use meals breakdown from mess settings mealCategories plus special Guest category. Backend calculates mealCount from meals, so guest meals increase that member's total. Backward compatible mealCount entries are also accepted. Body entries max 200. Duplicate messMemberId is rejected. Counts support 0.5 increments. Regular meals cannot exceed 3; total including Guest cannot exceed 50. Locked if that month has a finalized billing cycle. Also blocked for any entry where the member has an approved meal off request for that date; cancel the meal off request first to log meals again.

item.description: Production meal logging. Managers can log single or bulk meals with category breakdown such as Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner/Guest; backend stores both meals breakdown and total mealCount for billing. Guest meals are charged to the selected member. Members can read only their own meals. Meal records are locked after the monthly billing cycle is finalized and while an approved meal off request covers the member/date.

item.name: Meal Off Requests

query.description: Optional. Positive integer page number. Defaults to 1.
Optional. Positive integer page size. Maximum 100. Defaults to 20.
Optional. Allowed values: pending, approved, rejected, canceled.
Optional. Manager/super admin search by member name, email, phone, or mess member id.
Optional. Date range start alias. Returns requests whose off range overlaps the selected range.
Optional. Date range end alias. Returns requests whose off range overlaps the selected range.
Optional. Manager/super admin filter by mess member id. Alias: memberId.
Optional alias for startDate.
Optional alias for endDate.
Optional alias for messMemberId.
Optional. Use my to return only authenticated user records; omit or use all for manager all-records view.

request.description: Role: Member+. Lists meal off requests with pagination and filters. Managers/super admins can list all requests in the mess. Members can list only their own requests. Query: page, limit (max 100), status=pending|approved|rejected|canceled, searchTerm, messMemberId/memberId, start/end or startDate/endDate. Date filters use range overlap logic. Response shape: { success, message, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages }, data: [...] }. Each request item exposes _id and does not include id. In each item, populated messMemberId includes user, messRole, and status; the populated user object is exposed as user for consistency with members list. Reviewed requests include reviewedBy and reviewedAt; legacy approvedBy rows are normalized to reviewedBy in the response. Use scope=my on this endpoint for authenticated user meal-off requests.

Role: Member+. Creates meal off request. Start/end dates cannot be in the past, and pending/approved requests cannot overlap for the same member. Body supports optional messMemberId; members default to themselves and managers may create for another active meal participant.

Role: Manager. Reviews a meal off request. Body: { status: "approved" | "rejected" | "canceled" }. pending requests can become approved or rejected; approved requests can become canceled. Review audit is stored in reviewedBy and reviewedAt. Approving future dates creates/updates meal records with mealCount 0 and blocks meal logging for those member/date values. Canceling allows normal meal logging again; existing zero meal records can be overwritten by meal logging.

item.description: Meal off request management. Members create requests, managers approve/reject/cancel through a single status update endpoint.

Role: Manager. Marks utility bill as paid. Requires messId and billId variables.

item.description: Utility bill tracking. Managers create bills and mark as paid.

response.name: Get Market Schedules (Member+) - Sample with Data

query.description: Optional. Positive integer page number. Defaults to 1.

originalRequest.description: Role: Member+. Lists market schedules. Requires messId variable.

request.description: Role: Manager. Body: { assignedTo (unique active same-mess member ObjectId[], min 1, required), targetDate (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime, required, cannot be past), shoppingItems (array of {name, quantity}, required), estimatedBudget (number, positive, required) }. Dates are normalized by Dhaka day. Assigned members are populated as assignedTo[] objects with _id, messRole, status, and user details.

Role: Manager. Updates a pending market schedule. Body fields are optional: assignedTo (unique active same-mess member ids), shoppingItems (array of { name, quantity }), estimatedBudget (positive number). Use this endpoint to reassign duties by changing assignedTo. Does not update actualSpent; actualSpent is provided when completing the schedule via PATCH /market-schedules/:scheduleId/status.

Role: Member+. Completes assigned schedule if assigned; managers can complete/void. Body: { status: completed|void, actualSpent, fundSource }. Pending schedules cannot be completed before their target date.

item.description: Market schedule management. Lists support page, limit, status. Managers create/update/reassign by editing assignedTo. Completion/void use one status endpoint. actualSpent is submitted only when completing a schedule.

item.name: Menu Plans

query.description: Optional. Positive integer page number. Defaults to 1.
Optional. Positive integer page size. Maximum 100. Defaults to 20.
Optional. Allowed values: draft, published, archived.
Optional date range start alias.
Optional date range end alias.
Optional alias for startDate.
Optional alias for endDate.

request.description: Role: Member+. Lists menu plans with pagination and filters. Query: page, limit(max 100), status=draft|published|archived, start/end or startDate/endDate. Use startDate and endDate with the same date to fetch a specific day.

Role: Manager. Creates a draft menu plan. Date accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime and is normalized by Dhaka day. For manual creation, send meals with keys matching mess.settings.mealCategories. For AI generation, send isAiGenerated=true and omit meals. Optional AI fields: aiPreference (e.g. healthy, low cost, Bangla), aiBudget, avoidRecentDays (0-30, defaults to 7). Backend uses mess mealCategories and recent menu context to avoid repeated meals.

response.name: Create AI Menu Plan (Manager) - Sample Body

originalRequest.description: Role: Manager. Creates a draft menu plan. For manual creation, send meals with keys matching mess.settings.mealCategories. For AI generation, send isAiGenerated=true and omit meals. Optional AI fields: aiPreference (e.g. healthy, low cost, Bangla), aiBudget, avoidRecentDays (0-30, defaults to 7). Backend uses mess mealCategories and recent menu context to avoid repeated meals.

request.description: Role: Manager. Updates meals for a non-archived menu plan. meals keys must match mess.settings.mealCategories.
Role: Manager. Updates menu plan status through one endpoint. Body: { status: "published" | "archived" }.

item.description: Menu planning for daily meals. Menu plans use dynamic meal category keys from mess.settings.mealCategories, support pagination/status/date-range filters, and use one status endpoint for publishing/archiving. AI generation can use meal categories, preference, budget, and recent menu context to produce draft suggestions. Menu plans do not affect meal counts or billing directly; AI shopping can generate market lists from menu plans.

Role: Manager. Updates draft AI shopping list status through one endpoint. Body: { status: "approved" | "rejected" }.

Role: Manager. Body: { assignedTo, estimatedBudget }. Converts approved list to market schedule. Assigned members must be unique active same-mess members and the list target date cannot be in the past.

Role: Manager. Archives notice and unpins it. Requires messId and noticeId variables.

item.description: Complaint management. Lists support page, limit, status, scope=my, and searchTerm. Managers update open/in_progress complaints through one status endpoint; resolved/rejected statuses are terminal.

item.name: Subscriptions

request.description: Role: Public. Lists available subscription plans (no authentication required).
Role: Manager. Gets current mess subscription with plan details. If a mess has no subscription row yet, backend initializes the default active plan before returning. Requires messId variable.
Role: Manager. Gets subscription history. Requires messId variable.

Role: Manager. Subscribes to an active plan by plan code or plan id. Use planId=free for Free. Paid plans initialize an SSLCommerz payment session and return gatewayUrl; frontend must redirect the user to gatewayUrl. SSLCommerz fail/cancel callbacks will not overwrite an already validated payment.
Role: Manager. Cancels paid subscription by falling back to the default Free plan. Requires messId variable.

item.description: Subscription management for frontend integration. Use plans/current/history/subscribe/cancel from the app. SSLCommerz callback routes still exist in backend for the payment gateway but are intentionally hidden from this collection. Module routes are backend-guarded by plan.features: meals, expenses, billing, reports, marketSchedule, aiShopping, notices, and complaints. Active member approval is also limited by plan.maxMembers.

request.description: Role: Super Admin. Creates a subscription plan. billingCycle allowed values: free, monthly, yearly. code can contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores. If isDefault=true, other plans are unset as default. features controls backend module access for known keys: meals, expenses, billing, reports, marketSchedule, aiShopping, notices, complaints, prioritySupport.

Role: Super Admin. Updates a subscription plan by MongoDB plan id. If isDefault=true, this plan is forced active and other plans are unset as default. features can be partially updated with known feature keys to turn module access on/off.
Role: Super Admin. Deletes an unused non-default plan. If subscriptions already reference the plan code, the plan is deactivated instead. Default plan cannot be deleted.

Role: Super Admin. Updates user global role. Body globalRole allowed values: user, manager, super_admin. Guard: a user cannot be downgraded to globalRole=user while they are manager of any active mess; transfer ownership first. Requires userId variable.
Role: Super Admin. Updates user account status. Body status allowed values: active, blocked. Use blocked to block user, active to unblock. Requires userId variable.

Role: Super Admin. Updates mess platform status. Body status allowed values: active, suspended. suspensionNote is optional and useful when status=suspended. Suspended messes are blocked for managers and members; super admin can still access. Activating a mess clears suspensionNote, suspendedAt, and suspendedBy.

item.description: Platform administration. Strictly restricted to super_admin global role. Includes user, mess, stats, subscription plan management, and manager access request review.
